mapper.update: INSERT INTO DONGOPKG_USR ( PKG_CODE, CNFRM_STEP_CODE, COM_CODE, CNFRM_USER_ID, DFND_COL1, DEL_YN, USER_SEQ, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{PKG_CODE}, #{CNFRM_STEP_CODE}, #{COM_CODE}, #{CNFRM_USER_ID}, #{DFND_COL1}, #{DEL_YN}, (SELECT DECODE(MAX(USER_SEQ),NULL,'0', MAX(USER_SEQ))+1 FROM DONGOPKG_USR WHERE PKG_CODE = #{PKG_CODE} AND CNFRM_STEP_CODE = #{CNFRM_STEP_CODE} ), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #{st_kep_user_id}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #{st_kep_user_id} )
